macros.doc: Mark changes in the implementation section of the package documentation with the command \changed[〈label name〉]{〈v1.0〉}{〈2016/05/22〉}{〈description〉}.

macros.name: inlinetoc
macros.doc: Just a customized table of contents. Horizontal rules before and after, and spacing is adjusted, and no “Contents” title.

macros.name: metatruefalsearg
macros.doc: ‘\metatruefalsearg’ typesets as ‘〈true | false〉’.

macros.name: noteabstractafterspacing
macros.doc: The spacing below (\noteabstractafterspacing) and above (\noteabstractbeforespacing) the abstract can further be specified, also as macros.

macros.name: noteabstracttextfont
macros.doc: The font used for the text of the abstract is set by \noteabstracttextfont.

macros.name: noteabstracttextwidth
macros.doc: The width of the whole abstract text is determined by \noteabstracttextwidth.

macros.name: noteparagraphsetfonts
macros.doc: It takes two arguments, the font definitions to apply for headings of level \paragraph and \subparagraph.

macros.name: notesectionallfont
macros.doc: Define the \notesectionallfont and \notesectionallfontfamily, which control the general font used in section headings.

macros.name: notesectionallfontfamily
macros.doc: Define the \notesectionallfont and \notesectionallfontfamily, which control the general font used in section headings.

macros.name: notesectionsetfonts
macros.doc: The macro \notesectionsetfonts is a shorthand to set all section font definitions for the section-level commands \section, \subsection, and \subsubsection.

macros.name: notesmaller
macros.doc: Set the font size to a fraction of the surrounding font size. The fraction may be specified as an optional argument.

macros.name: notesmaller
macros.doc: Set the font size to a fraction of the surrounding font size. The fraction may be specified as an optional argument.

macros.name: notesmallerfrac
macros.doc: The fraction by which \notesmaller typesets smaller text when no optional argument is given.

macros.name: notetitlehrule
macros.doc: Allow customization of the horizontal rule below the title. The macro expands to commands which generate the rule, such as “\hrule height 1pt”.

macros.name: phfnoteEmail
macros.doc: The text is displayed as a hyperlink, which when clicked opens a e-mail composer to that address (via a mailto:XXX link).

macros.name: phfnotePdfLinkColor
macros.doc: The command \phfnotePdfLinkColor may by used to set the color of the links. It takes one argument, a color specification understood by the xcolor package.

macros.name: phfnoteRestoreDefs
macros.doc: Restores the macro saved by \phfnoteSaveDefs.

macros.name: phfnoteSaveDefs
macros.doc: The command \phfnoteSaveDefs{〈identifier〉}{〈list of macro names〉} saves the current definitions of the given list of macro and associates them to the given identifier.

macros.name: pkgname
macros.doc: Provide Macro: \pkgname{〈package name〉} to format a package name.

macros.name: pkgoptionfmt
macros.doc: Whenever a package option is formatted with \pkgoptionfmt, it is placed in the index.

macros.name: pkgoptionfmt

macros.name: thanksmark
macros.doc: \thanksmark[N] works with \thanks as \footnotemark works with \footnote. It just displays the given number as a footnote mark.
